name: freshprobe
description:
Data freshness verification for AI agents. Probes endpoints for HTTP cache staleness, latency percentiles, content fingerprinting, TLS certificate health, DNS timing, and redirect chains.
Returns deterministic FRESH/STALE/UNKNOWN JSON verdicts with policy evaluation and NIST AI RMF mapping.
